August 1st 2025: The Bread Basket Boys called the Popdarts National Championship on ESPN Ocho Day, broadcasted on ESPN2 at 5 p.m. EDT.

Between hilarious commentary and a mid-game table toss, it was chaos … and absolute magic. Rewatch the viral moment below.

The Bread Boys Took Over the First Annual Popdarts National Championship on ESPN8.

If you watched the first-ever Popdarts National Tournament hosted by the American Popdarts League (APL) on ESPN, there’s a good chance you weren’t just talking about the intense gameplay. You were talking about them, the Bread Basket Boys.

In their iconic ensemble, blazer and swimming trunks included, the Bread Basket Boys showed up in style and instantly became the stars of the sidelines. They didn’t just commentate. They dominated the energy of the event with over-the-top reactions, outrageous banter, and yes, you saw it right, a table flip that shook the internet.

Seriously, they flipped a table. And the internet lost it.

Who Are the Bread Basket Boys?

The Bread Basket Boys are a viral duo known for bringing wild, unfiltered energy to sports commentary. This was their Popdarts debut, and they made sure no one forgot it. From the first throw to the final celebration, they brought a mix of chaos, comedy, and hype that perfectly matched the intensity of the action.

Colton's Victory and the $6,000 Moment

As Popdarts Prodigy, Colton Davis sealed his victory and claimed the $6,000 check and trophy, the Bread Basket Boys were right there. Screaming. Jumping. Fully locked into the moment. Their reactions? Unmatched. Their commentary? Electric. Their shorts? Questionable, but unforgettable.

Why Everyone’s Talking About the Bread Basket Boys and Popdarts

Searches for “Bread Basket Boys Popdarts ESPN,” “Popdarts tournament table flip,” and “Popdarts Bread Basket Boys commentators” have skyrocketed since the tournament aired. People can’t get enough of this duo’s wild energy and honestly, neither can we.

This Is Just the Beginning

With the Bread Basket Boys crashing into the Popdarts scene and Colton putting on a championship performance, this tournament set the tone for what’s next for the American Popdarts League. The community is growing. The energy is real. And the hype? Off the charts.

Stay tuned. More madness is coming.
